scope: SQL Server smalldatetime minute and year-end rounding boundary
contract: The SQL Server 29.998-second input rounds down to the current minute, including at 2024-12-31 23:59.
The 29.999-second input rounds up across midnight/year end to 2025-01-01T00:00:00.
BookiE datetime results and SQL Server style-126 text agree for the within-minute and year-end values.
CSV export parses back into typed smalldatetime values; binding the below-threshold and rollover values into a fresh table reproduces the native style-126 text.

focused_test.result: 1 passed; covers native result/text, CSV typed parse, parameter insert and native re-read

remaining: Other SQL Server native rounding boundaries, non-SQL consumers and temporal grid combinations remain open; this case does not close B3 or qualify 0.2.0.
